entities.summary: Denys Raboula Antoine Beylouni is a Lebanese Syriac Catholic hierarch, who served as Archbishop of Aleppo of the Syriacs from 1991 to 2000 and subsequently as Curial Bishop of the Syriac Catholic Patriarchate of Antioch until his retirement in 2011. He has held the title of Titular Archbishop of Mardin of the Syriacs since 2000.
